annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council)
key_provisions_or_claims: Lists 16 draft laws to submit to the NPC Standing Committee, including the Railway Law revision and Energy Law.
Lists 16 administrative regulations to be made or revised, including the Interim Regulations on Flight Management of Unmanned Aircraft.
Plans a Network Data Security Management Regulation and a Biotechnology R&D Safety regulation.
Requires risk assessment throughout legislation, filing and review of regulations, and Party leadership of legislative work.
Assigns drafting units; the Ministry of Justice coordinates and supervises.
annotation.summary_en: The State Council General Office circular issuing the State Council's 2022 legislative work plan. It sets Party-led legislative priorities and lists laws and administrative regulations to be drafted, including the interim regulations on unmanned aircraft flight management, with no AI or robotics-specific content beyond that.
annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于印发国务院2022年度立法工作计划的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council on Issuing the State Council's 2022 Legislative Work Plan
